messages:
maria: Quick idea — add a 'preview' mode for automatic fallback policies so we can DRY-RUN rollouts without affecting real traffic. who wants to weigh in?
kevin: love the idea. main ask: the preview must produce the same telemetry and decision traces as live so audits are meaningful. no point if it's only a UI mock. :thumbsup:
sam: +1. also need a way to simulate transient errors vs sustained capacity loss. preview should let us inject error signals (5xx, timeout, queue-full) and see decision path.
jia: quota implications — if preview triggers a fallback candidate, we should not consume customer quota or bill for fallback model tokens. preview must be free and isolated.
maria: agreed on billing. thinking internal toggle: preview=true on the rollout API. example: POST /v1/rollouts/:id/simulate {"preview": true, "signals": ["latency_spike"]} — thoughts on surface?
kevin: API looks fine. ensure sim results include the same decision metadata keys we log in prod: route_reason, precedence_score, kv_cache_hit, model_variant. we need those for replay.
liz-ux: For the console, make preview a first-class action on policy page. show side-by-side: "expected live" vs "preview result" with expandable trace. keep it compact, avoid long JSON dumps. use badges for triggers that fired.
sam: On triggers: watch out for oscillation tests. preview must optionally run with hysteresis so we can test threshold hysteresis without destabilizing. add params: hysteresis_ms, min_samples.
jia: Also add a "no-op audit" mode where preview records an audit-event id that gets stored but doesn't change routing. we can link audit ids to incident timelines.
maria: Nice. ops-bot: deploy check?
ops-bot: ci/cd: rollout-sim-service passed. image: gcr/redwood/rollout-sim:2026-03-20-rc3
kevin: Implementation note: keep simulation path in the routing service not the runtime; runtime should accept a decision override for preview sessions so we can validate end-to-end without touching production routing tables.
liz-ux: UX question — should previews be shareable? e.g., copyable link to a preview session (with expiry) so PM/SE can review a simulation.
sam: shareable links OK if we guard with ACLs and expiry. also rate-limit previews per-operator to avoid accidental load.
jia: telemetry retention — preview traces should use shorter retention and a preview flag so they don't pollute long-term metrics, but still be searchable for 7 days.
maria: edge case: what if the preview shows fallback candidate is a private model not available in customer region? preview must show compatibility warnings.
kevin: yeah show compatibility matrix and fallback priority rank. also surface estimated latency delta and cost delta for chosen fallback.
liz-ux: UI sketch: top row = inputs (signals, region, customer tier), middle = decision trace (compact nodes), bottom = key metrics (latency, cost, quota impact). action buttons: Save as draft / Run live / Share.
ops-bot: note: ran a smoke sim with sample traffic id=sim-20260320-01, returned 12 decisions, 2 fell back, 1 had quota conflict.
maria: Awesome. next steps: kevin & sam prototype API & sim harness, liz make a small console mock, jia define retention/billing rules. sync Thu 10am?
kevin: I'm on. will sketch schema for simulate endpoint before then.
sam: I'll add signal injector in sim harness.
jia: I'll write the retention + billing doc and post in #eng-platform after this.
liz-ux: I'll post a Figma with the compact trace by EOD. :sparkles:
maria: Thanks all — aiming to have a usable preview test by next week.
_meta: generated for dataset: rollout automatic fallback policy UX (degrade modes, error triggers, audit)
